name: Aramco
verdict: Aramco is the Saudi state's economic engine and is state-controlled: the Government of Saudi Arabia holds 81.48% directly and the state's PIF a further 16%.
note: Rating note: Ownership source: Fitch Ratings, 'Saudi Arabian Oil Company', 2025-01-31 (https://www.fitchratings.com/research/corporate-finance/saudi-arabian-oil-company-31-01-2025); Aramco FY2025 Annual Report states the Government remains largest shareholder at 81.48%. Aston Martin Aramco F1 title sponsor (aramco.com).

why.text: Aramco is controlled by the Saudi state: the government holds about 81.5% directly and its fund PIF a further 16%. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024, and US intelligence assessed that the crown prince approved the operation that killed journalist Jamal Khashoggi. A famous team makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
